reason: Schedule and feasibility lens. The calendar has slack, but the plan cannot run as written. Five problems. (1) Build order is backwards. The idea builds the pre-short-track slot (step 5) AFTER the grid (step 3). No tail replay can test that slot offline: replay.py replays only the exp29/exp39 tail, with no flow relink, readmit or gap filler, and no x138-on-train harness exists. build_capture_kernel.py is exp51 detection-only capture with no edges, ILP or tail. So the slot dump or its tail replay must be in the train-run kernel BEFORE the 199-video run. Otherwise the slot needs a second 13-16 GPU-h run. (2) The GPU estimate is 30-50% low. The x138 hidden run takes about 7.5 h for about 100-130 videos (CONTEXT l.14 and probe latencies), about 3.5-4.5 min per video. That gives 12-15 session-h for 199 train videos, plus about 0.3 h setup per shard: 13-16 GPU-h, not 10. The 7.2 GPU-h exp51 capture was detection only, 2.2 min per video. (3) x138's runtime guard (REPAIR_DEADLINE_S 27000 s from kernel start, DIFF.md l.73/97) quietly switches off relink, gap close, safe divisions and linefit for later videos in any shard that runs past 7.5 h. x138 also writes its geffs only after all prediction and ILP, so a shard cannot resume. Shards must stay at 5 h or less, or the lab kernel must raise the deadline. The idea says only '2 sharded sessions', and 2 shards of about 100 videos each run 7-8 h, which trips the guard. (4) Agent work is about 8-10 h, not 3. The work is: a train-run builder for x138; kernel knobs for mid_um and sister_min (they exist only as div_insert params, not kernel env knobs); a 'never steal from edge_prob==0.0' flag that defaults off with byte-parity tests; an x138 dump replayer and writer plus official scoring; and an x138 short-track, rescue and linefit replay for the slot, checked for parity against the final-graph dump. On top of that, kdn-score must be re-parametrised: build_notebook.py is hard-wired to coords_exp39.parquet and dataset biohub-l2-coords. The in-kernel DaughterNet p on train is in-sample, so a new coords parquet, a dataset upload and an OOF kernel run are on the critical path. (5) GPU owner and conflicts. Friend A has made no commits since 24 Sep 04:12 MSK, his PC rebooted, and he is told to WAIT for #34 (PROMPT_FRIEND_A.md top block). Any output from sasyami must be shared as a dataset. If vitalii runs it instead, 15-17 of his 30 weekly GPU-h go to one lab cache for a change the LB cannot see (+0.000..+0.001; sibling value verdict v_divisions_divins-x138-lab-retune_value.json). That leaves about 13 GPU-h for every other probe's dummy run (about 0.7 h each) and nothing for retraining ideas. Probability arithmetic (GUESSES): P(#34 confirms the x138 base and #35 >= #34 - 0.003) ~0.7. P(the pipeline reaches a submitted probe by 28 Sep, given go) ~0.85. P(the pre-registered CONFIRMATION gate passes) ~0.3-0.4 (the idea's own 0.35; sibling: P(pass | true 0) = 0.28). So P(a scored probe of the retuned config by 29 Sep 10:00) is only about 0.2, and about 0.6 before the gate. Conditional on go and a gate pass, the calendar works with P ~0.85: submit about 18:00-20:00 on 26 Sep, scored 27 Sep 02:00-06:00, about 52 h before the deadline. Cited numbers check out: 12 insertions / 5 steals / 0 on 44b6_0b24845f / readmit 1,337 (CONTEXT 25 Sep 08:40); exp48 0.948 vs exp47 0.947 (CONTEXT 24 Sep 11:20). The mid_um 6.5, cos 0.25, sister 3-20 and steal_prob_max 0.3 defaults are in tools/div_insert.py:54-71.
